item.title: Ex-Anthropic, OpenAI employee warns about AI development speed
item.description: Jacob Coxon, a former safety researcher at Anthropic and OpenAI, discussed AI development pace on "This Week with George Stephanopoulos."

item.title: Jeffries urges lawmakers to 'act urgently' on AI
item.description: House Democratic Leader Jeffries said on "This Week" that lawmakers must "act urgently" on artificial intelligence.

item.title: El-Sayed calls for public oversight of AI
item.description: Michigan Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed said artificial intelligence carries "a lot of real risks."

item.title: Iranian vessel hit in Hormuz as Houthis expand shipping lane control
item.description: Iran-backed Houthis expanded control over the strategic Bab-el-Mandeb strait amid continuing strikes in the Strait of Hormuz.
